title: Harmonic Lane: Console workspace index & surface orchestration
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Rearchitect the Console left rail and workspace index so that cross-workspace tasks (dashboards, rollouts, cost views) surface reliably, reduce discoverability friction, and enable quick context-switching for multi-tenant users. Deliver a high-fidelity prototype, acceptance criteria, and handoff assets for frontend implementation.
scope: In-scope: left rail IA, workspace index panel (search + recent + pinned), contextual route mapping for dashboards/rollouts/cost views, keyboard navigation, compact collapsed state. Out-of-scope: global permissions model, backend routing logic, billing API changes.
goals: 1) Reduce time-to-open a target dashboard or rollout by 30% for power users. 2) Surface critical cost-breakdown views within 2 clicks. 3) Provide a stable set of affordances for canary/A-B rollout navigation that engineering can instrument. 4) Ensure the design supports both single-tenant and multi-tenant workspace flows.
acceptance_criteria:
- Prototype demonstrates left rail expanded/collapsed states and workspace index flows.
- Usability test (n=8 engineers/PMs) shows median task completion time decreased vs baseline.
- Edge cases documented for long org names, >50 workspaces, and role-based link hiding.
- Dev handoff spec with annotated components and responsive tokens delivered to engineering repo.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Overloading left rail with too many entry points causing cognitive load. Mitigation: Prioritize entries via telemetry (most used routes first) and surface secondary items in workspace index.
Risk: Conflicts with dedicated customer RBAC surfaces. Mitigation: Add role-aware placeholders and default to enterprise flag gating.
design_decisions:
- Adopt a two-tier rail: global roots (Home, Search, Workspaces) + contextual roots (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost Lens).
- Workspace index becomes a lightweight overlay anchored to the rail with persistent search and MRU (most recently used) row.
- Use compact icon-only rail at narrow widths with hover-expansion to full labels to preserve vertical real-estate.
- Keyboard shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens workspace index and supports fuzzy search and quick actions (pin, open in new tab).
deliverables:
- Figma: high-fidelity prototype (expanded/collapsed, workspace overlay, rollout path).
- Interaction spec: keyboard flows, animation timings, aria attributes.
- Usability report with 8 participant notes and prioritized fixes.
- Handoff bundle: tokens, component props, annotated CSS variables, acceptance checklist.
